apps.localizedDescription:
LecCheck:

Mark every lecture, practice and lab you attend, and see your semester at a glance. Fast, offline-first, and synced live between your phone and computer — for free.

Android · iPhone · Linux · (Windows coming).

LecCheck 2 is a from-scratch rebuild of LecCheck v1. v1 saved the whole app as one JSON blob and rebuilt every screen on each tap; v2 keeps a local SQLite database on every device, redraws only what changed, and syncs individual fields in the background — so it is instant, works offline, and never loses edits.

Features:

• Today — what's on now or next with a live countdown, one-tap Attended / Missed / Watched, and a "needs marking" queue (swipe right = attended, left = missed, with undo).

versions.localizedDescription:
Beta. Not yet verified on every device: reminders and their buttons, the Android widget and the iPhone build. Please report problems in Issues.

What's new:

• A calmer way to mark a session. One Attended button with a menu for the other statuses replaces the green and red buttons; the color only shows once it's marked.
• Today is less crowded: the session in the big card isn't listed again in the schedule.
• Stats starts with your courses: overall attendance, then each course with its requirements under it. On phones the charts fold under More details.
• Settings on phones is a short list of categories, each on its own page.
• Days off stand out on Week: the whole day is tinted with its name at the top, and a new icon replaces the umbrella. The date stays visible.
• A saved recording is one tap away: "Recording link" opens it, and Edit changes it.
• Reception hours: turn them on in Settings → Courses, add them to a course like a meeting, and they show on Week as an outline. They never count toward attendance.

• Clearer Hebrew: statuses read as nouns, like נוכחות and היעדרות, and other awkward wording is fixed.

Downloads:

• Android: LecCheck-2.0.0-beta.17-android-arm64.apk for most phones, or the universal LecCheck-2.0.0-beta.17-android.apk.
• iPhone: in AltStore or SideStore, add this source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Emanuel4100/LecCheck2/altstore/altstore-source.json
• Linux: install the Flatpak, then it updates itself: flatpak install --user https://emanuel4100.github.io/LecCheck2/leccheck.flatpakref (or open leccheck.flatpakref in your software center). Installed with install.sh before? 2.0.0-beta.15 offers Move to the Flatpak; from an older one, install the Flatpak as above and sign in or import a backup.
